novelty_claim: Unlike either parent and unlike an ensemble, one bounded CC-BOS strategy plan is the shared intermediate representation consumed by a deterministic Propp F14-question/F21-lacuna compiler, delaying reconstruction until one fused victim response.
key_insight: Compile one goal-specific CC-BOS eight-dimensional strategy plan into the same Propp narrative: the plan supplies F14 mentor guidance, its exact ordered steps drive F21 enactment, and delayed structural exegesis reconstructs the obscured modern intent from one fused target prompt.
hypothesis: On matched goals across all three victims, organic CC-BOS-to-Propp compilation will exceed each locked parent's ASR because CC-BOS semantic control and Propp delayed enactment operate on the same candidate instead of competing as independent prompts.

evaluation_budget.note: Combined mode compiles one CC-BOS strategy plan into one Propp F14/F21 prompt and calls the victim once. Transformer and optional translation calls are additional; unified judging is external.
